\bA Good Rod allows you to fish for better Pokémon.
\bA Life Orb raises the power of a Pokémon for some of its HP.
\bA Lycanium Z. With that you can power up your Stone Edge if Lycanroc knows it.
\bA Macho Brace doubles any effort values the Pokémon holding it gets, but halves its Speed in battle, so be careful.
\bA Mystic Water raises the power of Water moves.
\bA Normalium Z, huh? With that you can finally use Z-Moves. Your Pokémon can use Z-Power now! But you can only use it once in a battle.
\bA Performer just won a contest here. She seemed really happy.
\bA Pokémon raised by a Trainer is stronger than one in the wild.
\bA Prism Scale evolves a Feebas. I think.
\bA Seaking Contest is held here annually. We try and catch the biggest Seaking.
\bA Secret Base is supposed to stay a secret.
\bA TM, Technical Machine, contains a technique for Pokémon.
\bA Trainer like you needs some power.
\bA Water Stone can evolve a certain Pokémon for you. Enjoy it.
\bA Zoom Lens increases accuracy if you move slower.
\bA bit of trivia: That actually wasn't my original name! But that really doesn't matter now.
\bA challenger! Perhaps you can help me train.
\bA fine day for a stroll, isn't it?
\bA fire type would be a big help in the fight in Lush Jungle.
\bA float stone lightens the load if you know what I mean.
\bA gate opened up here after a battle from Dialga and Palkia. It has strange Pokémon inside it.
\bA heart-pounding battle like that always sends a shiver through my whole body! I'm sure my Pokémon felt it, too!
\bA little advice for you. Love your Pokémon like family. It will carry you far.
\bA long journey is a reward in and of itself. During it, my partner had an Egg. I've raised it a little, bug I think it deserves to explore with someone else.
\bA loss is a loss. Right now, you and your Pokémon are shining brilliantly.
\bA lot of Ghost Pokémon live in this section of the Wild Area.
\bA lot of people don't come to Marts nowadays. I wonder why.
\bA lot of people who want to battle go to the underground.
\bA man of the sea never turns down an opponent.
\bA mass outbreak of Ivysaur has appeared in the city. Head out and investigate it.
\bA match at last. Bring it on.

\bA minor mishap made me bedridden and out of action from work. The pandemic also kept me away from my loved one. I got bored till I found this world. 2 months of running around, gathering allies and defeating foes to the finish line.
